spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Spacious, minimal, fintech-grade UX (Cred, Zerodha Kite). Generous white space. Progressive disclosure.

animation_specs.philosophy: Subtle fade-ins and slide transitions only, no bouncy effects.

progress_bar.description: Sticky progress bar across stages 1-6 with 6 dots.
progress_bar.layout: flex items-center justify-center gap-3 py-4 sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#F8FAFC]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#E1E5EB]/50
progress_bar.dot_active: w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#0B2545] transition-colors duration-300
progress_bar.dot_inactive: w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#E1E5EB] transition-colors duration-300
progress_bar.dot_completed: w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#13A8A8] transition-colors duration-300

tappable_chip.description: Used instead of dropdowns or text inputs.
tappable_chip.base: px-5 py-3 rounded-xl border-2 transition-all cursor-pointer text-center font-medium w-full flex items-center justify-center

segmented_control.item_inactive: flex-1 text-center py-2.5 text-[#475569] font-medium text-sm transition-all hover:text-[#0B2545]

slider.thumb: block w-6 h-6 bg-white border-2 border-[#13A8A8] rounded-full shadow-md focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#13A8A8]/50 cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing

loading_state.spinner: w-8 h-8 border-4 border-[#E1E5EB] border-t-[#13A8A8] rounded-full animate-spin

stage_0.notes: Hook landing. Use the navy texture image blended with the 5% gradient at 10-20% opacity as a fixed background. Big CTA bottom-anchored on mobile.

stage_2.notes: Family snapshot stage. Subtle usage of the family image in a top banner card, lightly blurred with an off-white overlay.

stage_6.notes: Audit report. Must render 4 tappable score cards in 2x2 grid on mobile (4-across desktop). Use 'score_card' design.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the selected fonts: Cabinet Grotesk for Headings, Inter for Body. If Cabinet Grotesk is unavailable via standard Google Fonts, use 'Outfit' or 'General Sans' but maintain the tight tracking and heavy weights for H1/H2.

Implement progressive disclosure explicitly: state variables must trigger Framer Motion layout animations when revealing the next slider or chip group. Do not show the next question until the current one is answered.
Use Phosphor icons (bold or duotone) for a premium fintech feel.
Do NOT use raw HTML inputs for complex interactions (use Shadcn Slider, Tabs, Input OTP).
All interactive elements must have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='start-audit-button').
Format currency in Indian format: ₹XX,XX,XXX (Lakhs/Crores) using Intl.NumberFormat('en-IN').
Use 'flex-1' and 'min-h-[100dvh]' for main layouts to ensure the bottom-anchored CTA behaves correctly on iOS Safari.
Ensure all Stage 1-6 layouts accommodate the sticky 6-dot progress bar at the very top without content overlapping underneath.
All components should be in .js/.jsx, not .tsx as per the environment rules.
